name: What happens during a gas line pressure test?

mainEntity.name: What happens during a gas line pressure test?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a gas line pressure test, a certified technician will first shut off the gas supply and disconnect any gas appliances. They then connect a pressure gauge to your gas piping system. Air or an inert gas is introduced into the lines, pressurizing them to a specific level. The pressure gauge is monitored for a set period. If the pressure remains stable, the system passes; if it drops, a leak is present and will need to be located and repaired.
acceptedAnswer.description: A technician shuts off gas, pressurizes the lines with air, and monitors a gauge for pressure drops to detect leaks.
